## K-02  Scheduled reports, without being asked for

Monday 08:00. Four aggregate queries against the registers - pipeline, money waiting on somebody, the full compliance horizon and a 30-day agent leaderboard - rendered into one HTML email with an inline funnel and the 15 worst-expiring items named, with their owners.

Nothing is typed and nothing is estimated: every number is a `COUNT` over your own tables.

Add addresses to `recipients` in the **Config** node, comma separated. For a monthly director pack, duplicate the workflow and change the schedule to *Months*.

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_sal_001 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'New')        AS leads_new,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_sal_001 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'Contacted')  AS leads_contacted,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_sal_001 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'Qualified')  AS leads_qualified,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_sal_001 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'Converted')  AS leads_converted,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_sal_001 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'Lost')       AS leads_lost,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_sal_005 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'Scheduled')  AS viewings_booked,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_sal_007 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'Pending')    AS offers_open,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_txn_001 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'Open')       AS deals_open,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_txn_005 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'Closed'
     AND NULLIF(closing_date,'') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
     AND closing_date::date >= CURRENT_DATE - 7)                              AS deals_closed_7d,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_sal_001
     WHERE created_at >= to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc') - interval '7 days',
                                 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'))                  AS leads_this_week,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_sal_001
     WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('New','Contacted')
       AND COALESCE(NULLIF(agent_assigned,''), '') = '')                      AS leads_unassigned;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_txn_004 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Pending','Finance Verified'))
                                                                              AS commissions_awaiting,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(net_commission,0)),0)::numeric FROM frm_txn_004
     WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Pending','Finance Verified'))             AS commissions_value,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_fin_001 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'Pending')    AS claims_pending,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_fin_004 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Pending','Verified'))
                                                                              AS payments_pending,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_cmp_002 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'High Risk')  AS aml_high_risk,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_cmp_005 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Open','Investigating'))
                                                                              AS compliance_open,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frm_it_008 WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Open','Investigating'))
                                                                              AS security_open;

WITH tracked AS (
  SELECT 'COR-001' AS form_code, 'Corporate Document Register' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("document_name", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("responsible_person", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("expiry_date", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_cor_001
  WHERE NULLIF("expiry_date", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'COR-002' AS form_code, 'Licence & Permit Register' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("licence_permit", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("responsible_person", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("expiry_date", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_cor_002
  WHERE NULLIF("expiry_date", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'COR-003' AS form_code, 'Master Compliance Calendar Item' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("compliance_item", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("responsible_person", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("due_date", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_cor_003
  WHERE NULLIF("due_date", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'COR-005' AS form_code, 'Power of Attorney Register' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         doc_no AS item, NULL::text AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("valid_to", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_cor_005
  WHERE NULLIF("valid_to", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'HR-002' AS form_code, 'Employee Master Information Form' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("full_name", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("full_name", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("visa_expiry", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_hr_002
  WHERE NULLIF("visa_expiry", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'AGT-002' AS form_code, 'Agent Master File' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("agent_name", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("agent_name", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("broker_card_expiry", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_agt_002
  WHERE NULLIF("broker_card_expiry", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'SAL-009' AS form_code, 'Call Log' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("agent_name", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("agent_name", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("follow_up_date", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_sal_009
  WHERE NULLIF("follow_up_date", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'PRO-003' AS form_code, 'Owner Authorization' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("property_ref", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("owner_name", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("valid_to", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_pro_003
  WHERE NULLIF("valid_to", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'PRO-005' AS form_code, 'Marketing Authorization' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("property_ref", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("owner_name", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("valid_to", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_pro_005
  WHERE NULLIF("valid_to", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'IT-001' AS form_code, 'Asset Register' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("asset_type", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("assigned_employee", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("warranty_expiry", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_it_001
  WHERE NULLIF("warranty_expiry", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'VEN-003' AS form_code, 'Vendor Contract Register' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("vendor_name", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("vendor_name", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("end_date", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_ven_003
  WHERE NULLIF("end_date", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MKT-002' AS form_code, 'Marketing Plan & Strategy' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("owner_name", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("owner_name", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("next_review_date", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_mkt_002
  WHERE NULLIF("next_review_date", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MKT-004' AS form_code, 'Creative Brief' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         doc_no AS item, NULL::text AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("deadline", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_mkt_004
  WHERE NULLIF("deadline", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MKT-005' AS form_code, 'Marketing Content Approval' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("property_ref", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULL::text AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("permit_expiry", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_mkt_005
  WHERE NULLIF("permit_expiry", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MKT-007' AS form_code, 'Digital Advertising Campaign Setup' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         doc_no AS item, NULL::text AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("end_date", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_mkt_007
  WHERE NULLIF("end_date", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MKT-008' AS form_code, 'Advertisement Budget Approval' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         doc_no AS item, NULL::text AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("period_end", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_mkt_008
  WHERE NULLIF("period_end", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MKT-009' AS form_code, 'Lead Generation Campaign' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("campaign_name", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULLIF("owner_name", '') AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("end_date", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_mkt_009
  WHERE NULLIF("end_date", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MKT-013' AS form_code, 'Website Content Update Request' AS form_title, id, doc_no,
         COALESCE(NULLIF("property_ref", ''), doc_no) AS item, NULL::text AS owner_name,
         NULLIF("required_by_date", '')::date AS due_date
  FROM frm_mkt_013
  WHERE NULLIF("required_by_date", '') ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')

  SELECT 'MKT-014' AS form_code, 'Social Media Account Access & Authorization' AS form_title, id, doc_no,

    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')

  SELECT 'MKT-017' AS form_code, 'Event / Roadshow Marketing Request' AS form_title, id, doc_no,

    AND COALESCE(status,'') NOT IN ('Superseded','Expired','Revoked','Terminated','Closed','Completed','Archived','Exited','Cancelled')
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE due_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE due_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 30) AS red,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE due_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE + 31 AND CURRENT_DATE + 90) AS amber,
  COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'item', item, 'form_code', form_code, 'id', id, 'doc_no', doc_no,
    'owner', owner_name, 'due', to_char(due_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'days', (due_date - CURRENT_DATE))
    ORDER BY due_date) FILTER (WHERE due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 30), '[]') AS worst
FROM tracked;

SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.leads DESC), '[]') AS agents FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(agent_assigned,''), '(unassigned)') AS agent,
         COUNT(*) AS leads,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'Converted') AS converted,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status,'') = 'Lost') AS lost
  FROM frm_sal_001
  WHERE created_at >= to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc') - interval '30 days',
                              'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
  GROUP BY 1
) x;
